## Checklist

- [ ] Generated via `uv run page-swingly` (not hand-crafted assets)
- [ ] Not a copyrighted/trademarked character
- [ ] Ran `uv run page-swingly-publish` and committed `swingly/public/characters/<slug>/`
- [ ] Ran `uv run page-swingly-validate` locally and it passed
- [ ] Previewed it in the demo site (`npm run dev` in `swingly/`) and it hangs/swings correctly
